name: Arc Side
source:
Maya, Estia, and Flare are three magi apprentice girls training in magic at the foot of Mount Tokias. They enjoy everyday life under instructions from grandfather of swordsman Lestin. But fate starts to move on that day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
